scripts.build: bun run --bun tsc --noEmit && bun run --bun vite build --configLoader native
scripts.serve: bun run migrate:serve && OPENQUEST_PERSIST_PATH=.runtime/state bun run preview
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bun run --bun wrangler deploy
scripts.migrate:local: bun run --bun wrangler d1 migrations apply openquest --local
scripts.migrate:serve: bun run --bun wrangler d1 migrations apply openquest --local --persist-to .runtime/state
scripts.migrate:remote: bun run --bun wrangler d1 migrations apply openquest --remote
